topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: I noticed something unusual about the house next door today. It was the car, sleek and expensive, a model I knew cost more than my salary for a couple of years. The contrast with the modest exterior of their home made me pause. Walking the dog later, I saw curtains drawn shut, a new security camera perched discreetly. It all added up to a puzzle, a quiet enigma. Curiosity aside, I found myself admiring the privacy they've managed to maintain, even with such wealth. It's rare these days, a sort of understated dignity that’s hard not to respect.
